description: Installed desktop layout for the AURA backend + bundled Python MT5 bridge. This mirrors src/platform/windows/PackagingConfig.{h,cpp} and src/platform/windows/PathResolver.{h,cpp}; the runtime resolves every path from the executable location, never the CWD.

runtime.note: A release bundle ships a self-contained interpreter distribution (Windows embeddable build or equivalent). A system interpreter is a development-only fallback and must be requested explicitly. The authoritative bundled location is resources/python/ (PathResolver.cpp, BundleLocator.h, HANDOFF.md); PackagingConfig.h declares 'python/python.exe', which resolves to resources/python/python.exe, matching the locator (C-1 fixed).
